verdict.rationale: Zep's docs explicitly show adding conversation memory via thread.add_messages (which both stores history and ingests it into a persistent user-level knowledge graph) and retrieving it later via hybrid semantic+BM25 graph search or a composed Context Block, with sub-200ms retrieval regardless of graph size, directly matching the story of persisting and recalling context across sessions. Community commentary corroborates Zep's focus on long-term conversational state and its evolution toward Graphiti to improve recall quality, though this is not independently benchmarked in the pack. Missing for 10: independent/third-party quantitative validation of retrieval accuracy and long-horizon session recall beyond vendor docs.
